title: Implement and prove shared accept-loop lifecycle over authenticated bridge sessions
sourceBackedBasis: LWB-R7-100 first-server-only flag, failed-connection retry and cleanup boundary
LWB-R7-115 authenticated hello + registry route admission

implementation.owner: one loop object per shared host proof
implementation.firstServer: FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE used only for the first successfully created server object
implementation.replacementServer: all subsequent server objects omit first-instance flag
implementation.connectFailure: failed ConnectNamedPipe disposition drops instance and continues loop
implementation.handshakeFailure: rejected/timeout/malformed hello drops instance and continues loop
implementation.shutdown: cancellation observed while pending overlapped connect is polled; pending owner disposal issues CancelIoEx

nextExactGap: Bind startup registration and the recovered four LWBRIDGE_* launch environment values to the shared host state without yet enabling outbound command/result routing; then the normal host listener can be started before profile launch with source-backed cleanup on launch failure.
